title: Customer Shopping Trends Analysis
description: A customer-behaviour dashboard exploring common purchases, category mix, payment preferences, buying frequency and seasonal review patterns.
question: What do purchasing patterns reveal about customers, product demand and seasonal behaviour?
design: Organized customer and purchase measures into a coherent dashboard, placing summary indicators alongside category distributions, product rankings, buying frequency and time-based comparisons. Filters support exploration by season, category and gender.
focus: Customer and purchase indicators summarize the dataset at a glance
Product-ranking charts show commonly purchased items
Category and payment comparisons reveal useful shopping patterns
Seasonal filtering connects behaviour to time
reflection: The value of a shopping dashboard is in connecting the headline numbers to the habits and categories behind them.
coverAlt: Original Customer Shopping Trends dashboard with total customers, average age, purchase amount, product frequencies, category and gender distributions, payment method and seasonal comparisons
